title: Stability Analysis of Decentralized Adaptive Control of Laterally Coupled Multi-Loop Thermosyphon System with Unknown System Parameters
summary: A high dimensional bi-directionally coupled $N$-loop thermosyphon system in a tandem is modeled by $3N$ Lorenz type of differential equations. The fluid flow in each loop is driven by the heat source (Rayleigh numbers) as well as the moment and heat exchanges between the adjacent loops. The flow becomes chaotic when the Rayleigh numbers are large. A decentralized controller design via proportional local state feedback is employed to stabilize the chaotic flows in each loop.
